system.description: Per-card Vital Bracelet routes for the six Frontier DIM cards (Set EX3/EX4/EX5 Legend Spirits: Agnimon, Fairimon, Chackmon, Wolfmon, Blitzmon, Louwemon). Collected 2026-11-19 by a script from the humulos.com chart (vbdm/ex) and detail pages (device 13 = VB DIM/EX cards). `cardStages` is the stage the card's chart column puts each species in (the Hybrid Digimon have no stage of their own on Wikimon); `cardAttributes` is the card's attribute of each Hybrid (Wikimon: Variable). Each edge is a route between two species of the card with its kind, the stated requirements and the source text. Third-party quotes: review before a public release (see README).

kinds.normal: stat requirements (Vital Values, trophies, battles, win ratio)
kinds.fallback: taken when nothing else is met

flamon.deviceRules: Vital Bracelet DIM card (humulos 'Agnimon EX', Premium Bandai, Legend Spirits sets; details device 13). VB Dim rules: Trophies. Baby I -> Baby II is time-only; Baby II has a 1,200+ VV route and its 0-1,199 VV fallback; each Child has one stat route and a fallback; Adults and Perfects have stat routes and attribute-Jogress routes (the device checks the backup for a partner of the same stage). Some Ultimate routes need Adventure stage 15 cleared. The Hybrid Digimon stand in the chart's stage columns like the rest of the card.
